item.title: Every device Xiaomi announced at MWC 2026
item.description: From Honor to Huawei, there’s no shortage of tech giants unveiling their upcoming products at Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 in Barcelona, but Xiaomi has certainly taken the cake with an abundance of devices. With flagship phones, smartwatches and even a super stylish power bank in the mix, there’s something for everyone. item.title: The Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra’s privacy display may have a major flaw
item.description: The Galaxy S26 range hasn’t even gone on sale in most markets yet, but a potential problem with the Ultra’s display has already been flagged. The Ultra is the only one of Samsung’s fresh flagship phones to have a key new feature: its world-first privacy display. It’s a combination of hardware and software that will turn your screen black when viewed from an angle. It can even block certain parts of the display, such as pop-up notifications. item.title: I tried the Razr Fold, a Galaxy Z Fold 7 alternative
item.description: Motorola is shaking up its line-up, having announced the Motorola Signature and the Motorola Razr Fold in January 2026. The Signature is available, but Motorola kept the exact specs of the Razr Fold under wraps until now. I reviewed the Motorola Signature recently, a phone that’s designed to set a new bar for Motorola and take things to a new level of luxury. item.title: Nothing Phone (4a) shown in all 4 colours, Pro still missing
item.description: Nothing has revealed the Phone (4a) in its full selection of colours at Mobile World Congress in Barcelona. item.description: In summary: iPhone 17e priced at £599/$599 Pre-order from 4 March 2026 Upgrades include MagSafe charging and a storage bump The iPhone “e” model is Apple’s take on a budget smartphone. But it’s budget on Apple’s terms. Even though it’s the most affordable model that Apple sells new, it’s not low-cost compared to Android rivals. item.title: Honor’s Robot Phone isn’t just a fun concept
item.description: One of the most interesting devices at MWC 2026 this year is Honor’s Robot Phone and it turns out that it’s not just a concept, destined to stay on the lab shelf. Honor has been teasing the device, but the mobile-focused show in Barcelona is the first time it’s been properly shown doing its thing. In what Honor is calling “a new species of smartphone”, it primarily contains a hidden camera which is mounted on a motorised gimbal. item.title: The iPhone 17e feels like a plate of warmed-up leftovers
item.description: The iPhone 17e has arrived and if I’m not underwhelmed, it’s fair to say that I’m not overwhelmed either. Whelmed might reasonably describe my response. For months I’ve been following the rumours and, to be fair to the leakers and tipsters, most were right on the money – to the extent that there wasn’t one thing that Apple announced that was a surprise, except for the new, pale pink colourway. item.title: Ghosts, the fan-favourite British TV series, is getting a film sequel
item.description: If you thought it was time to say goodbye to the ghosts of Button House once and for all, you’re sorely mistaken. The BBC comedy show about a couple living in a haunted house is returning as a feature. Ghosts: The Possession of Button House is written by Mathew Baynton, Simon Farnaby, Martha Howe-Douglas, Jim Howick, Laurence Rickard and Ben Willbond, the writers and creators of the original Ghosts TV series.
